question: Guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) with all four pillars — ACEi/ARNI, beta-blocker, MRA, and SGLT2i — is recommended for patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), defined as LVEF ≤40%.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. HFrEF = LVEF ≤40%. The four-pillar GDMT is evidence-based for this phenotype. Patients with preserved EF (HFpEF) have very limited pharmacological options with proven mortality benefit.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. HFrEF is defined as LVEF ≤40% (some guidelines use <40%). All four GDMT pillars have mortality-reduction evidence specifically in HFrEF. Patients with HFpEF (LVEF ≥50%) or HFmrEF (40–49%) have different (and more limited) pharmacological options.
